cohort: 122 pregnant women with diabetes (21 with PGDM and 101 with GDM) and 244 non-diabetic controls matched for gestational age and parity at the University of Port-Harcourt Teaching Hospital, Nigeria between 2008 and 2012.
finding: Diabetes in pregnancy is associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including a high rate of macrosomia (49%), perinatal mortality (90 per 1000 deliveries), caesarean delivery (89%), and neonatal intensive care admission (49%).
mod_finding: The caesarean delivery rate among women with diabetes was 89%.
